text: When my son got a word wrong yesterday it kept coming back at the top of the list today, which felt right. But new words never seemed to appear until everything else was done.
It felt too hard for a week straight. Could it notice the child is struggling and drop a grade sooner?
Words I rated 'unsure' still vanished for many days. I expected 'unsure' to bring them back the next day.
Please make sure a lucky guess on the multiple choice does not count the same as actually knowing the word.
Contact me at parent@example.com or +1 415 555 0199 if you want details, the date was 2026-10-13.
